title: Study finds common vaping additives disrupt lung-surfactant film in lab model
summary_en: A new study from the University of Kansas shows that additives common to commercially available vaping devices, vitamin E and CBD, soften a vital lung surfactant at high enough concentrations, at least in a simplified lab model.
title_cn: Study finds common vaping additives disrupt lung-surfactant film in lab model

title: KU to host inaugural Democracy Day, featuring presentations by university researchers
summary_en: The Center for Democratic Governance at the University of Kansas is hosting its first annual Democracy Day “Teach-In” Event on Sept. 18 in the Alderson Auditorium of the Kansas Union.
title_cn: KU to host inaugural Democracy Day, featuring presentations by university researchers

title: KU Architecture Lecture Series to explore contemporary architectural practice in Mexico
summary_en: Award-winning architects from some of Mexico’s most influential contemporary practices will visit the University of Kansas this fall as part of the Architecture Lecture Series, “Re-Generations.” Through four public presentations, speakers will share perspectives on design, urbanism and the evolving role of architecture in shaping communities and culture.
title_cn: KU Architecture Lecture Series to explore contemporary architectural practice in Mexico

title: ‘News Desert U’ book explores what happens when ‘universities own the news’
summary_en: The new book “News Desert U” examines six university community partnerships in which faculty and students produce news for communities that have lost coverage. The book’s authors, including a University of Kansas journalism faculty member, explore lessons learned and argue for more support from universities to faculty who are leading such efforts.
title_cn: ‘News Desert U’ book explores what happens when ‘universities own the news’
